title: Chestnut Grove
description:
EXPERIENCE CONFINEMENTWhen your daily life is confined to a small area, you start to take a closer look at the familiar. See how the crisis impacts your usual environment.

CHESTNUT GROVE is a short first-person experience, created to document the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic through a personal lens.

This game is a short walking simulator with some light puzzles and can usually be completed within 30 minutes.

FEATURES• a short first-person experience portraying life during the early COVID-19 pandemic.

• a focus on atmosphere and mood.

• all documents featured within the game are authentic and taken from real life

• light puzzles and environmental interactions.
description_short: How do you go about your life when self-isolation has become the new normal? CHESTNUT GROVE is based on my personal experience of quarantine and features 100% real documents and notices.
